runtimeDeepVerification.purpose: Runtime/code/public-GET verification for ThemeB, テーマA, and Automation SEO. Split facts into code-confirmed, runtime-confirmed, both-confirmed, hypothesis-only, and AGENT NEO design reflection.

scope.local: Docker WordPress 6.9.4 / PHP 8.3 / MariaDB 10.11. Theme switching, plugin active/inactive checks, HTTP, Lighthouse, Playwright, WP-CLI.
scope.publicSites: Public GET-only observation for production テーマA and ThemeB sites. No authentication, no POST, no setting changes, no write operations.

deliverables: 解析レポート/36-実環境検証レポート.md
解析レポート/37-ファイル解析確定事項と新発見.md
findings: ThemeB has 64 block.json files and is stronger for block-level AI operation.
テーマA has integrated SEO head/JSON-LD design but needs an adapter layer because it has no block.json and relies more on AJAX/customizer patterns.
テーマA 1.4.6 emits PHP 8.3 warnings around customizer settings during WP-CLI execution.
The production テーマA site shows heavier plugin/image/DOM load and weaker runtime output than the production ThemeB site.
Automation SEO is REST-centric and AI-friendly, but namespace discovery is required because local uses seo-tool/v1 while production exposes aseo/v1.
AGENT NEO should standardize section_id, cta_id, content_role, schema_role, and measurement_id as first-class theme contracts.

themeSide: Expose blocks, sections, CTAs, schema, and measurements through stable JSON contracts.
Make SEO head, JSON-LD, canonical, OGP, robots, sitemap references, and indexability verifiable output contracts.
Separate public tracking routes from protected write/media/update routes.
Add audit, dry-run, rollback, and capability-matrix assumptions before AI write operations.
automationSeoSide: Add REST namespace discovery and route capability matrix.
Add theme adapters for ThemeB-like block.json themes and テーマA-like HTML/AJAX/customizer themes.
Run weekly Lighthouse, Playwright, REST, HTML, sitemap, and robots observations and store diffs.
Treat public production checks as GET-only unless the owner explicitly authorizes authenticated write validation.

confirmedByCode: Automation SEO connector REST route and cron registration
confirmedByBoth: ThemeB REST route exposure and block-oriented design
テーマA SEO integrated output and PHP 8.3 warning risk
hypothesisOnly: Paid update server contract and license enforcement internals
